finding.root_cause: The target-player and PA-opportunity path had no positive, replayable contract binding prior-game opportunity records to predeclared capture windows and no raw official-schedule denominator proving which prior games were expected. Real-source inspection also proved that MLB's fields query still returns unrequested nested player fields, so the transport body was not truthfully opportunity-only. Runtime integration then exposed that the upstream active-roster ledger verified schedule byte hashes but did not replay schedule chronology and game/team identity, and did not bind its manifest contract/code fields during verification.
